title: Tunable electrocatalytic H2 evolution activity of nickel-dithiolene coordination polymers
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5869-5881
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01084E, Paper
Yashna Khakre, Tyler K. Pham, Smaranda C. Marinescu
A tunable nickel-triphenylenehexathiolate CP is presented that produces H2 from water in acidic media with a 91% faradaic efficiency, and displays stability for over 28 h.
